title: AITA for not dating people who have mental issues?
question: AITA for not dating people who have mental issues?
body:
I have a personal rule to never date a person who is depressed or suffering from any mental health complications. I don’t want to deal with them especially since I am not the most stable myself when it comes to my emotions (although I do not suffer from anything as far as I know).

I previously dated a self proclaimed autistic person and she was a manipulative bitch who tore apart my life. So, with this as my previous experience, am I really the asshole for not wanting to date people who have mental health issues or claim to suffer from mental health issues?
